name: Duck Hunt
tagline: Click the ducks. The dog laughs. In a GIF, no server.
description:
This is Duck Hunt in a GIF. There is no install and no server. Open the file, click a duck, and the dog will tell you how you did. Close it, come back — your best run lives in the file.

Ducks fly left and right. You have three shots a wave. Miss too many and the dog laughs. Hit enough and the next round is faster.

On a phone it is the same tap. There is no zapper to plug in.

Send the invite and a friend can sit the same pond on their device. There is no lobby. The room is the link.

An unofficial remake based on DuckHunt JS by MattSurabian, MIT-licensed. Pictures and sounds are from that port. This copy adds the save.
